english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something seems or appears to be a certain way.
Use 好似 when “look” means seem or appear to be something.

examples.english: I seem to think they aren't feeling well.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 ci5 m4 syu1 fuk6

examples.english: You look like you're not feeling well today.
examples.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 m4 syu1 fuk6 wo3
